info.title: MoneyMgr API
info.description: Personal finance API. Amounts are integer minor units; every success body is `{ data }`.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
Email a password-reset link (always 202, so it never reveals whether an email is registered)
Set a new password with a reset token; signs out every session
Confirm an email address with the emailed token

post.summary: Change the password (signs out other sessions)

get.summary: Exchange rate between two currencies on a date

delete.summary: Delete a transaction (both legs of a transfer)

get.summary: Income, expense, net and savings rate for a range
Income and expense per day for a range (zero-filled, max 400 days)
Twelve monthly buckets for a year
Spend versus limit for budgets active on a date

patch.summary: Update, pause or resume a rule

post.summary: Import v1 investment documents (dry-run supported, idempotent)

get.summary: Portfolio totals in the base currency
Portfolio value and invested amount at each month end

post.summary: Record a price (or total value for pooled assets)
Record a trade, contribution or withdrawal

delete.summary: Delete a tag (removes it from its transactions)
Delete a goal and its contributions

get.summary: What you are owed and what you owe, per currency

delete.summary: Delete a debt and its payments

get.summary: Monthly or yearly report: totals, comparison with the previous period, categories, accounts, top expenses, budgets
